verdict.rationale: SOSPortal is an online, 24/7 account-based portal that documents 'Enhanced security through multi-factor authentication,' which points to a remote credential-MFA sign-in path. The published pages never describe the MFA factors or rule out biometric liveness, in-person identity proofing, or a mailed PIN. The filing host blocks AI agents, so the sign-in flow itself could not be checked. Missing for 10: documentation of the specific MFA factor types, explicit confirmation that no biometric, in-person, or mailed-PIN step is required, and hands-on or independent corroboration of the sign-in flow.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the published sign-in path is credential MFA an authorized human can complete remotely — not biometric liveness, an in-person visit, or a PIN by physical mail

citations.quote: SOSPortal has replaced SOSDirect and SOSUpload. Start a business, perform name searches and do much more.
